players.product: Indium phosphide (InP) wafers (2-4 inch) for optical-communication lasers and detectors, made by subsidiary Yunnan Xinyao Semiconductor Materials; also gallium arsenide wafers and germanium products (germanium ingots, germanium tetrachloride for optical fiber, solar germanium wafers, infrared optics)

quarterly_data.signal: Management (IR record): the 'germanium wafers for space solar cells' project started in March 2025 with an 18-month construction period, adding new capacity to reach 125 ten-thousand wafers/year (4-inch equivalent) by end-2025 and 250 ten-thousand wafers/year (4-inch equivalent) when fully built; construction is proceeding on plan.
quarterly_data.figure: 125 ten-thousand wafers/year by end-2025; 250 ten-thousand wafers/year at completion (4-inch equivalent)

quarterly_data.signal: Management (IR record): in PV-grade germanium, downstream customers are strongly wait-and-see in H1 2026, purchasing has shifted from annual tenders to monthly tenders or toll processing, and buying is mainly for rigid (essential) demand.

Management (IR record) on the H1 2026 fall in infrared-grade germanium revenue: since 2024 the rapid rise in germanium prices has suppressed civilian demand, and downstream mid- to low-end users have markedly accelerated R&D and optical validation of substitute materials such as chalcogenide glass; material substitution has sped up further in recent years, so infrared germanium demand is trending down.
